title: Persistent eventual overlap equation for one pair of recovered local maps
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram, and $c$ a limiting cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}$ followed by Spec with affine vertex [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions]. Fix $i\le k$, a quasi-separated morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], and finitely presented quasi-coherent modules $F,G$ on $X_k=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_k)$ [def-pc-base-change, pqf-def-coherent]. Let $U$ be an open cover of $X_k$ and fix indices $a,b$ whose cover members are affine. Write $p:X_c\to X_k$ for the limit map [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions]. Let $\delta:p^*F\to p^*G$ and local maps $r_x:F|_{U_x}\to G|_{U_x}$ whose limit pullbacks, conjugated by the canonical restriction comparisons [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison], equal the restrictions of $\delta$. Then there is $l\ge k$ such that for every $m\ge l$ with $k\le m$, the family $s_x=e_x(F)^{-1}\circ q_x^*(r_x)\circ e_x(G)$ on the pullback cover along $q:X_m\to X_k$ satisfies the descent-morphism square for the fixed pair $a,b$ on every test scheme mapping to both cover members. Here $e_x$ is the canonical tensor restriction comparison for $q$, and the transitions in the square are the ordinary restriction descent data of $q^*F$ and $q^*G$. No finite-cover assumption, simultaneous bound for all pairs, or composition with other global maps is asserted.

theorem finitePresentation_local_map_pair_eventually
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [QuasiSeparated f]
    (k : I) (hik : i ≤ k)
    (F G : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hik)))).Modules)
    (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hFq : F.IsQuasicoherent)
    (hG : G.IsFinitePresentation) (hGq : G.IsQuasicoherent)
    (U₀ : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hik)))).OpenCover.{u})
    (a b : U₀.I₀) [IsAffine (U₀.X a)] [IsAffine (U₀.X b)]
    (δ : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (overlapLimitMap R c f hik)).obj F ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (overlapLimitMap R c f hik)).obj G)
    (r₀ : ∀ x, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U₀.f x)).obj F ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U₀.f x)).obj G)
    (hr : ∀ x,
      let p := overlapLimitMap R c f hik
      let e := Scheme.Modules.openCoverTensorPullbackComparison p U₀ x
      e.inv.app F ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U₀.pullbackHom p x)).map (r₀ x) ≫
        e.hom.app G = (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U₀.pullback₁ p).f x)).map δ) :
    ∃ (l : I) (hkl : k ≤ l), ∀ (m : I) (hkm : k ≤ m), l ≤ m →
      let q := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hik))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hik.trans hkm)))))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hkm)))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
      let U := U₀.pullback₁ q
      let Q := modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData U.f
      let C := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q
      let r : ∀ x, (Q.obj (C.obj F)).obj x ⟶ (Q.obj (C.obj G)).obj x := fun x ↦
        let e := Scheme.Modules.openCoverTensorPullbackComparison q U₀ x
        e.inv.app F ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U₀.pullbackHom q x)).map (r₀ x) ≫
          e.hom.app G
      Pseudofunctor.DescentData.PairCompatibility r a b
